item.title: A Decal Trophy and Discounts for Italy’s National Unity and Armed Forces Day!
item.description:
Every year on November 4th, Italy celebrates National Unity and Armed Forces Day. The date marks the surrender of Austria-Hungary in the First World War, which allowed Italy to incorporate Trento and Trieste, thereby completing its unification. This holiday has been celebrated since 1919, although it has not been a public holiday since 1977.

The P40 “G.C. Leoncello” and M43 “G.C. Leoncello” are temporarily available for purchase with a 50% discount for 575 and 650 Golden Eagles respectively!

When: From November 4th (11:00 GMT) until November 7th (11:00 GMT).

Where: Italy > Army > Premium Vehicles.

About these tanks

  • The P40 “G.C. Leoncello” (rank II) was produced in a limited run of approximately 100 units. This medium tank featured robust, sloped armor designed to increase the likelihood of enemy shells ricocheting off. Its HEAT and armor-piercing (capped) rounds offer respectable penetration, and the tank is also equipped with a coaxial 8 mm machine gun and smoke grenades.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][/carousel]

  • The M43 “G.C.Leoncello” (rank III) is another rare vehicle, however it was a real menace to Shermans in the Italian campaign. Its HEAT shells can penetrate the frontal armor of most opponents, and the self-propelled gun itself is quite compact. Keep it hidden from enemy eyes and don’t hesitate to deploy a smoke screen if you’re spotted!

[carousel autoadvance="true"][/carousel]

Open the “National Unity Day and the Italian Armed Forces” trophy!

When: From November 4th (11:00 GMT) until November 7th (11:00 GMT).

Task: Earn 3,000 mission points in battles where you used Italian vehicles at rank III or higher to receive the “Italian National Unity and Armed Forces Day” trophy!

Inside this trophy, you’ll receive one of four decals that were previously available for this holiday:

“Italy's National Unity and Armed Forces Day” decal

“The Heart of Italy” decal

“Bersaglieri Cockade” decal

“Italian Unity” decal

The decals can be found in the Holidays section under vehicle customization.

If you already have all four decals, you’ll receive a trophy and get one of the following when opening it:

  • 20-50% Research Point booster for 3-10 battles

  • 20-50% Silver Lion booster for 3-10 battles

  • 3-5 universal backups

  • 1 day of Premium account

Please note: After finishing the task, you need to collect the reward manually.

Additional details:

  • You can complete the task in random battles, except for \[Assault] mode.

  • Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Italy’s National Unity and Armed Forces Day.

item.title: Planet Zoo 2 | Under Investigation
item.description:
Hayo Zookeepers, 

Welcome to our Under Investigation area for Planet Zoo 2. This is an article with key issues raised on our official issue tracker, alongside the status of planned fixes. This is not a full list of everything the development team are working on. 

This article last updated: Wednesday 4 November 

Latest Game Update – 1.0.8 (Thursday 29 October) 

Next Planned Game Update – Early Week Commencing 9th November 

 

Following launch, we promised to provide transparency on our team’s focus on fixing issues which you’ve raised so far. 

The team are currently testing fixes to the following issues for the next update; these are not final patch notes: 

Stability & Performance: 

  • Resolving several crashes

  • Resolving a hardlock in campaign storage, after claiming a reward in the conservation project UI in 

Franchise, Sandbox & Career:

  • Resolving an issue causing sold animals to sometimes incorrectly reappear in the animal storage UI

  • Removing accreditation requirements for Deluxe Edition species: 

    - Golden Eagle
    - Golden Lion Tamarin
    - Great Hammerhead Shark
    - Axolotl
    - Blue and Gold Fusilier

Park Management & Construction:

  • Resolving several issues which could cause staff to become stuck, holding on to boxed animals

  • Changes to guest appeal to balance visiting Food/Drink shops vs Restaurants

  • Resolving guests becoming stuck on benches with 0% energy

  • Improvements to the frequency which staff replace food in habitats

  • Resolving an issue in certain languages which would cause the ‘exit group’ button to continue offscreen

  • Resolving an issue where Raisin 4m strip bushes could slowly move every time the game was closed

Animals & Exhibits:

  • Resolving an issue where terrain requirements could become stuck at an incorrect value

  • Resolving an issue which caused Sand Tiger Sharks to become stuck

Wider Settings & Options:

  • Changing the ESC key to deselect items before closing a menu

  • Resolving an issue which prevents the ‘Travel to Wildlife Reserve’ button from being selected via the Planet Hub whilst Trading & Storage is open when using gamepads/controllers.

  • Adding a QR code onto the Planet Hub to allow players to access patch notes

     

Under investigation for future updates: 

  • Animals being boxed more frequently than usual

  • Incorrect animal animations (animals using animations which should not be possible, rigging rigidity)

  • Implementing automated exhibit population management

  • Greater control of seasons in Sandbox

  • Further Improvements to guest behaviours, such as usage of bins and benches

  • Guest & staff seasonal clothing

  • Additional sandbox maps, starting with North American Grasslands and European Grasslands 

 

Ongoing Areas of Focus 

These are specific areas which the development team have identified for regular ongoing improvements, due to the complex nature of Planet Zoo 2's simulation. 

  • Animals climbing, jumping, and pouncing will see ongoing improvements

  • Some animals not aligning with their enrichments correctly on occasion

  • Animals sometimes erroneously escape from habitats during certain behaviours

  • Further enhancements to core creative toolset

  • Repeated boxing and unboxing of animals

  • Resolving issues impacting saved games

  • Improvements to shoal behaviour and motion

     

Please note: This is not a full list of everything the development team are working on. If your issue has not been addressed in a previous update or is not listed here, you can report it here:

https://issues.frontierstore.net/reported-issues/planet-zoo-2

  

Thank you for your ongoing support of Planet Zoo 2 as we build a wilder world together! Check out the highlighted area of the workshop to find some of our favourite builds so far, share your best photos on social media, and join our discord to chat with other Zookeepers around the world. We’re also expanding the number of guides on our website, where you can learn all about harnessing Planet Zoo 2’s biggest changes; from the nature brush to accreditation!

item.title: [Notice] Key Issues on Early Access Launch Day and Our Response Plan
item.description:
Hello, Pioneers.

Thank you for joining us for the Early Access launch of ArcheAge Chronicles.

On launch day, we received a large number of reports and suggestions through our Discord bug report channel, Steam Discussions, and other community platforms. We are carefully reviewing the feedback you have shared with us.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who has encountered issues that have prevented them from progressing or enjoying the game as intended.

Below, we'd like to share the major issues identified so far, our plans to address them, and some workarounds you can try in the meantime.

1. Fixes Ready for Deployment (Schedule to Be Announced)

We have completed fixes for the following issues and are working to apply them to the game as soon as possible.

  • Unable to Progress Through the Tutorial: Some players have encountered an issue that prevents them from progressing through certain tutorial quests.

  • Boss Fails to Spawn: In certain boss encounters, leaving the area and returning can cause the boss to stop spawning.

Additional fixes are also included in this update. We will share the full details once the changes have been applied.

2. Under Investigation

Malchuk Encounter and NPC Dialogue Progression Issues

  • We are investigating an issue where, after dying during the Malchuk encounter, the boss may fail to appear again or players may be unable to respawn.

  • We are also aware of quest progression issues that can occur after speaking with NPCs in certain areas, including Cliffs of Madness.

  • We are currently investigating the root causes and conditions that trigger these issues.

If you encounter either of these issues, please share the details of what happened in our Discord bug reports channel. Your reports will be a great help in identifying the causes.

Progression Blocked When a Party Disbands or the Party Leader Leaves

  • We have identified an issue where progression may become blocked or players may be unable to move to the next area if the party leader leaves or the party disbands while running a dungeon.

  • Due to the underlying structure of this issue, a fix may take some time. In the meantime, please keep your party together until you have moved on to the next area after completing a dungeon.

  • We have also confirmed that some key items are not shared among party members. When progressing as a party, please make sure each member obtains their own key.

Getting Stuck in the Terrain

If your character gets stuck in the terrain and cannot move, please try the following:

  1. Press ESC and select Escape.

  2. If this does not resolve the issue, restart the game, log in again, and try using Escape once more.

3. Improvements in Progress

Customizable Movement Key Bindings

We have received a lot of feedback from players who would like more flexibility when changing movement key bindings.

We plan to improve the controls so that movement keys can be freely reassigned, and will work to bring this change to the game as soon as possible.

Chat Display Settings

We have received reports that chat messages in unwanted languages are appearing, and that players would like an option to hide the chat window.

  • In the meantime, you can filter out unwanted languages through Settings > Game Options > Chat Language Filter.

  • We also plan to add an option to hide the chat window entirely.

Joining the Same Channel as Party Members

Currently, you can use the channel transfer button in the party UI to move to the same channel as your party leader.

However, the button only appears under certain conditions, and it is not always clear when it can be used.

We plan to improve the conditions under which the button appears, as well as the related guidance, to make this feature easier to understand and use.

4. Other Player Reports and Feedback

Unexpected Game Crashes

We plan to address some of the reported game crash issues in the next patch.

We will continue investigating and working to resolve additional crash issues as they arise.

Game Stuck During Anti-Cheat Initialization

The game may get stuck during the anti-cheat initialization process for various reasons.

If you encounter this issue, please take a screenshot of the screen where the problem occurs and submit a ticket through our Customer Support. Our support team will look into your case individually and assist you.

You can also access Customer Support from the in-game menu by pressing ESC.

Linux and Steam Deck Support

Linux and Steam Deck are not officially supported at this time.

We will continue to evaluate the possibility of supporting these platforms in the future.

Game Optimization

We have received a lot of feedback about stuttering and frame rate drops during gameplay.

Since performance issues can have various causes depending on each player's PC environment, it may take time to address every case.

However, we will continue working on optimization throughout Early Access to provide a smoother gameplay experience.

Gameplay Feedback

We have also received a wide range of feedback on various aspects of gameplay, including combat feel, class depth, and character progression.

We appreciate both the positive feedback from players who are enjoying the game and the constructive criticism from those who feel there is room for improvement. We are carefully reviewing all of it.

Early Access is an opportunity for us to refine the game together with you. We will continue making improvements based on the feedback you share with us.

Additional Language Support

We understand that players from different regions are requesting support for additional languages. Localization is also an important area we are actively considering.

We will take some more time to review requests from players across different regions and assess the available options before sharing further updates on our plans.

Once again, thank you for the tremendous interest and feedback you have shared with us since launch.

We recognize that there are still areas that need improvement, and that some unexpected issues have come up. We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been affected.

We are prioritizing the issues identified so far based on their impact on gameplay and working to resolve them in order. We will continue sharing updates through our announcements as fixes are applied and other major issues are identified.

We will keep working to provide a more stable and enjoyable experience as you explore Auroria.

Thank you for your patience and support.

The ArcheAge Chronicles Development Team

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2) Review
item.description:
My brother came home with a Nintendo 64, Super Mario 64, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time when I was nine, and because I was the youngest of four, he decided I wasn’t allowed a save slot or to touch the console at all. There was an empty slot sitting right there because one of my siblings didn’t want to play it, and he still held the line. So, whenever he was out, I’d sneak into his room and replay the opening and the Deku Tree for two months straight, beating Queen Gohma ten or twelve times without seeing anything past her.

One day I finally loaded his file out of curiosity and landed in Ganon’s Castle, ran up a spiral staircase past laser-shooting statues, and got obliterated by Ganondorf, because my brother was at the end of the game and I had no idea. A year later he relented, and the month that followed changed how I think about games. The first couple of temples as Kid Link were tutorials in disguise, teaching an entire generation how to exist in the 3D space.

item.title: Nexus Mods Forces Mandatory AI Disclosures and Filters, Explains Why It Won't Ban AI Mods
item.description:
Generative AI has taken over the modding scene, with modders mashing together existing games and using AI-assisted code to, for example, put the Nemesis system from Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor into Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption 2.

Nexus Mods, the biggest platform for mods on the internet, has reacted by enforcing mandatory disclosure for mods with AI-assisted code, and letting users filter AI-assisted mods out of their search criteria or preferences.

"We are pro-human creativity," Nexus Mods co-owner Victor 'Foledinho' Folmann said in a blog post, before further explaining why the site won’t outright ban AI mods entirely.

“You may ask me why [we won’t ban AI mods], since that is not the solution some of you were looking for,” he said. “The answer is simple: AI is currently used throughout the whole process of creation, from script autocompletion to generation of textures, voices, and full assets, and it is difficult to draw a clear boundary between what is acceptable and unacceptable."

Foledinho believes an outright ban would just encourage modders to hide AI use. “It should be out in the open, clearly labelled, and regulated according to the rules that we can implement on our platform," he said.

Modders will have to declare whether their mod is AI-assisted, primarily AI-generated, or features promotional material generated by AI. A “public explanation of how and where AI was used” is also required on the mod’s page.

The use of AI in development is perhaps the hottest topic in the video game industry. While Steam has an AI discosure policy for store pages, Valve does not limit AI-focused developer access to its platform, nor block "AI slop" from from it despite complaints from fans and developers about the deluge of low effort games that flooded the recent Steam Next Fest. Valve also put the onus on developers to ensure their game stands out amid the detritus. In particular, there’s been a big issue on Steam of developers having their games instantly cloned with AI as soon as they share any development progress.

"Rather than relying on a single mechanic that someone can easily copy, you need to keep growing your game by adding features, personality, and creativity that stem from your own perspective," Valve’s Tom Giardino recently said.

Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney recently called mandatory AI disclaimers “a political act,” criticizing Steam and Valve in particular. Meanwhile, indie game storefront Itch.io recently deleted what it called “terabytes of AI slop” flooding its service. "Just because you can upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI generated models doesn't mean you should upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI generated models," Itch said.

As for Nexus Mods, existing mods have a 60 day grace period to comply with the new rules. If they haven’t updated by January 2, they potentially face account restrictions. "As I said before, this is a complicated subject, and I don't expect everyone to agree with every decision we've made, or will make in the future," Foledinho added. "We've had to consider many sides and preferences when discussing it all; some people would prefer to prohibit AI-generated content entirely, while others embrace it and want fewer restrictions. We've considered both sides, but ultimately we need to make decisions we believe are right for Nexus Mods and our community as a whole."

Image credit: Nexus Mods.

item.title: Steam says it’s ‘running behind’ when reviewing pre-release games because of how many re-reviews it has to do
item.description:
Valve has told developers it’s “running a little behind” when it comes to approving pre-release game build submissions, because of all the re-reviewing it has to do.

Developers have to submit their build to Valve before their game can be released on Steam, to ensure it meets the storefront’s requirements.

While this process is usually only supposed to take a few days, however, some indie developers have been taking to social media and saying it’s taking longer, potentially resulting in their release dates being pushed back.

item.title: Best Mosin Nagant builds in MW4
item.description:
The best MW4 Mosin Nagant builds will vary depending on whether you're trying for sniping and range, for quickscoping, or want a versatile build that allows a mixture of strategies. Things get even more complex when you're considering whether you want to be prepared for the high octane multiplayer experience or for the slower, more complex DMZ experience. Fortunately, no matter your needs, I've got a full range of builds for the Mosin Nagant below, so you know the best attachments for it in Modern Warfare 4 and what they lean towards.

For more info on deadly loadouts, check out our list of the best MW4 guns!

Mosin Nagant all-rounder build


(Image credit: Activision)
  • Barrel: 762 Dozor Light Barrel
  • Muzzle: 330TC2 Gridlock Light Silencer
  • Laser: XRK Clutch-LS Dim ADS Laser
  • Bolt: TV-Light 7- Light Bolt
  • Stock: Lockwood Eagle Assault Stock
Great for both multiplayer and DMZ alike, this all rounder build has good enough ADS to make quickscoping viable, but can work at mid range too (though not long range owing to the lack of scope). The Light Silencer and Barrel are designed to prioritize scope scoping a little more than anything else, but if you want, try swapping either of them out for a Heavy Silencer and Barrel to lean it more in the direction of long-range sniping.

Mosin Nagant Sniper build


(Image credit: Activision)
  • Barrel: Mosin K025 Long Barrel
  • Muzzle: FTAC Silent Recon Heavy Silencer
  • Optic: GL K230 4X Scope
  • Stock: Lockwood Eagle Assault Stock
  • Magazine: 10 Round Mag
More suited for DMZ than multiplayer, this pushes the Mosin Nagant towards a long-range build designed to pick targets off at a healthy distance, with the FTAC Silent Recon Silencer preventing you from being easily found. Meanwhile, the Long Barrel and 10 Round Mag are there to ensure that you can do as much damage as possible with your first round, at which point it's probably time to relocate while you reload.

The big interchangeable factor here is the GL K230 scope, which is by no means an essential part of the build. I find that a 4X magnification is a good compromise between all kinds of range of combat, as if you go any higher, you might struggle to shoot at enemies who have closed the distance too much. Still, feel free to play with your options and see what feels best.

Mosin Nagant quickscope build


(Image credit: Activision)
  • Barrel: Mosin S762 Short Barrel
  • Laser: Schlager VISIV-5 Bright ADS Laser
  • Bolt: TV-Light 7- Light Bolt
  • Optic: SZ SRE-7 Reflex
  • Stock: No Stock
This atrocity of a build for the Mosin Nagant turns it into a short-range quickscoping machine, based mainly around the Short Barrel and the Light Bolt. This is a build made for short-to-mid range, bumping up the ADS to hit players hard, but not taking away from the gun's damage in the process. If you want, you can always try tweaking the specific optic - I found that the SZ SRE-7 Reflex was good enough for purpose, but like on the previous build, there's potential to tweak according to taste.

item.title: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel Teaser's In-Universe Quote Sparks Timeline Speculation
item.description:
This week's tease for The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel didn’t give us much to work with. Eight years since the last mention of the game, and all we got was a CGI sand dune. But that hasn’t stopped fans speculating about what it all means.

Most of the speculation is centred around the quote that ends the teaser trailer. “The scroll offered only a shimmer, a veil lifted thinly to my eyes,” it said. “A future lost. A victory undone. Sands of time scattered by fate.”

The quote was attributed to Yazar, Moth Priest of High Queen Irande of Hammerfell, where Sentinel is likely set. The year? 4E 206.

While this is clearly the year the quote was recorded, fans are wondering if that’s also when the game will be set. If so, it would mean Sentinel takes place just five years after the events of Skyrim, which in turn would mean the Dragonborn’s achievements would be fresh in the memory of people across Tamriel.

"Most of the issues present in Cyrodiil as of Skyrim (like the encroachment of the Aldmeri Dominion) likely still apply," redditor HowdyHangman77 suggested. "We’ll likely find out from some obscure book or one-off dialogue what happened with the Stormcloak Rebellion (given the Empire’s waning power across Cyrodiil, I suspect it succeeded, but who knows)."

“This quote being 4E 206 doesn't mean the game will take place around then, but it's possible,” said Inner-Chance. “If that is when it takes place, the Dragonborn will likely be in Skyrim during the events of Sentinel. We would probably see dragons coming over the border and the civil war would almost certainly not have a victor yet. What else would this mean for Sentinel if this is the timeline of the game?”

Dragons were one of the standout features of Skyrim — seeing them flying overhead, attacking villages and towns in unscripted ways. Those are some of the best emergent moments in TES history, so you can imagine Bethesda wanting to build upon those systems as well as riding on the popularity of Skyrim, the studio’s most-played game.

Hammerfell is a huge area that borders Skyrim, Cyrodil and High Rock. Dragons don’t care about borders. A five-year jump from Skyrim leaves the outcome of Skyrim's civil war and regional political tensions intentionally ambiguous. In the Fourth Era, Hammerfell transformed from a fractured Imperial province into an independent, sovereign nation.

The Thalmor, an Elven supremacist political faction and extremist paramilitary force of the Aldmeri Dominion, were promised a large chunk of Hammerfell by Emperor Titus Mede II in 4E 175 in an attempt to end The Great Warm which saw the elven armies launch a surprise attack on southern Hammerfell in 4E 171, overwhelming the Imperial Legions and forcing a retreat across the desert. The Redguards saw this peace offering as a betrayal and refused to hand over their lands. As a result, Hammerfell was renounced and became a sovereign nation.

By the time of the Dragon Crisis in Skyrim, Hammerfell exists as a battle-hardened republic. While a deep bitterness remains toward the Imperial throne for abandoning them, the indigenous Redguards maintain active trade and diplomatic ties with individual provinces like High Rock. Sentinel could see the Thalmor march north once more as dragons raid from the east. It’d make for an interesting geopolitical setup for an Elder Scrolls game.

Countering this speculation though is the suggestion that Sentinel could be set decades or even hundreds of years after Skyrim, and the quote we see in the teaser is nothing more than a snippet from a lore book detailing ancient history, or a prophecy only now coming to pass in the distant future.

"All we know is that the game is set AT LEAST 5 years after Skyrim, it very well could be 20, 50, or 100 years after," one fan said. "5 years after the events of Skyrim, a Moth Priest had a prediction about the future, glimpsed in an Elder Scroll. How far into the future, we just don't know," suggested another.

It's worth remembering that Skyrim takes place 200 years after Oblivion. Will Bethesda jump forward centuries, as it has done before, for Sentinel? Last month, The Verge reported that Sentinel will dive into the history of the Elder Scrolls themselves, allowing players to discover their secrets firsthand for the first time.

We've got plenty more on The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel in the wake of Bethesda's announcement, including word that it is reportedly still at least two years away from launch, and an in-depth explanation of what Sentinel means.

item.title: Best ArcheAge Chronicles graphics settings for no lag and max FPS
item.description:
ArcheAge Chronicles is now available in early access, and there’s a fair number of settings to tweak to get the best visual performance. The game is fairly graphic intensive, especially when it comes to the RAM department.

Thankfully, the in-game settings allow you to get the best possible performance out of your system.

Best ArcheAge Chronicles graphics settings
https://embeds.beehiiv.com/a8d62108-86ed-4039-bf49-44877ba62c15 Before I deep dive into the settings, here’s a rundown of my setup.

  • 32 GB of DDR4 RAM
  • AMD Radeon 9060XT 16 GB
  • AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
While my requirements matches perfectly the recommended requirements, I have focused more towards the lower-end devices. You don’t need to make too many changes if your device is already capable enough.

  • Screen Mode: Fullscreen
  • Vertical Sync: Off. You have to turn this on if you’re still getting a lag after making all the following changes.
  • VRS: Off
  • Upscaling: Off. Turn this on if you have a PC at the lower end of the power curve.
  • Upscaling Quality: Balanced
  • Low Latency Technology: Anti-Lag 2
  • Low Latency: Off
  • Character Display Limit: Default
  • Motion Blur: Off
  • Camera Shake: Off
  • Hit Reactions: Off
  • Frame Rate Limit: 60 FPS. Keep this at 60 FPS for starters and then test out the performance. If you’re not getting lag, you can raise it up to 90 FPS, but don’t go above that.
  • Graphics Preset: Custom
  • Anti-Aliasing Quality: Medium
  • Vegetation Quality: Low
  • FX Quality: Low
  • Lighting Quality: Medium
  • Post-Processing Quality: Low
  • Reflection Quality: Low
  • Contrast Quality: Low
  • Shadow Quality: Low
  • Texture Quality: Low
  • View Distance: Medium. However, turn this down if there are stutters.
With ArcheAge Chronicles, you’ll also want to pay attention to the quality of your internet. Packet bursts and inconsistencies will also lead to stutters and cause lag at your end. I am also expecting optimizations to appear in the game during the early access period.

The post Best ArcheAge Chronicles graphics settings for no lag and max FPS appeared first on Destructoid.
